projects.title: IdeaBuddy
projects.subtitle: Full Stack Idea Management Web Application
projects.desc: Full stack web application built from scratch that helps users capture, organize, and manage their ideas all in one place. Features user registration and login with secure JWT authentication, full CRUD operations for ideas, clean REST API with MVC architecture, and responsive frontend connected to backend. This project demonstrates how frontend and backend work together in a real-world application, from designing data models to building APIs and connecting them to the UI.

projects.title: TaskFlow AI
projects.subtitle: AI-Powered Mobile Productivity App

Features AI-assisted task planning and management, clean modern mobile UI, cross-platform Android app, and automated build pipeline with GitHub Actions. Built end-to-end including full deployment setup for real device testing. This project provided hands-on experience with mobile development using Flutter, integrating AI into apps, and setting up CI/CD pipelines for mobile applications.

projects.title: Quantum Fraud Detection
projects.subtitle: Quantum ML for Financial Fraud Detection
projects.desc: Variational Quantum Classifier (VQC) using PennyLane's 4-qubit architecture to detect financial fraud on real credit card data from OpenML. Achieved 93% precision, 81% accuracy, and F1 score of 0.78 on 197 transactions with ~20ms inference speed and 50 transactions/second throughput. Includes comprehensive comparison with classical ML models (XGBoost, Random Forest), demonstrating that quantum circuits can successfully classify financial patterns. Built with Streamlit web interface and 85 passing tests. Quantum model trades 7-10% performance for cutting-edge quantum ML approach, proving viability of quantum computing in fintech applications.

projects.title: ROME JARVIS
projects.subtitle: Personal AI Coding Assistant with Voice & Memory
projects.desc: Personal AI coding assistant featuring voice input via OpenAI Whisper, ChromaDB-powered memory system for contextual conversations, local text-to-speech for voice responses, and a robust 4-tier AI fallback system (Groq, Gemini, Together.ai, Mistral) ensuring high availability. Includes automatic codebase indexing and retrieval for project-aware assistance. Built as a powerful local-first development companion that understands your code and responds to voice commands, combining multiple AI providers for reliability and performance.
